environment.description: Kafka consumer deployed on EKS cluster. The file-upload-events topic receives messages from a REST API endpoint (/api/v1/files/upload) that is exposed through an AWS ALB without request validation. Any authenticated user can POST arbitrary JSON payloads that are forwarded directly to Kafka via a thin proxy service. The consumer pod runs with default securityContext and mounts an EFS volume at /var/uploads/pending. No content-type allowlist is enforced at any layer.

config.api_gateway: none - direct ALB to proxy service
